desc: Ideation: longest palindromic prefix via KMP on S + '#' + rev(S); answer = S + reverse(S[L:])

Implement and validate the complete Python solution: KMP prefix function on T = S + '#' + S[::-1], L = pi[-1], answer = S + S[:len(S)-L][::-1]; verified against samples (ABC→ABCBA, Z→Z, TREE→TREERT) and brute-force reasoning; final code uses fast I/O and iterative O(n) KMP.
